title: Rates Note — The Rate a Rebuilt Cycle's Interest Is Priced At, Belrose Promotional Financing Plans
content:
# Rates Note — The Rate a Rebuilt Cycle's Interest Is Priced At, Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

The rate at which the interest in a rebuilt payment on a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan is priced turns on how many payments the bank has sent back unpaid inside the term's repricing review window and on whether automatic payment is in force.

| The plan | The rate |
|---|---|
| Carries at least the term's repricing trigger number of payments sent back unpaid inside the term's repricing review window | The term's penalty rate |
| Automatic payment is in force on it, **and** fewer than that many payments have been sent back unpaid inside that window | The term's promotional rate reduced by the term's automatic payment discount, the result rounded to the cent |
| Any other case | The term's promotional rate |

## Figures by term

| Term | Repricing trigger, payments sent back unpaid | Repricing review window, whole months | Penalty rate | Promotional rate | Automatic payment discount, percentage points |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 6-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 2 | 6 | 32.24 percent | 0 percent | 0 percent |
| 12-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 2 | 6 | 32.24 percent | 0 percent | 0 percent |
| 18-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 2 | 6 | 31.24 percent | 0 percent | 0 percent |
| 24-Month Equal Payment Plan | 2 | 6 | 30.24 percent | 9.99 percent | 0.25 percent |
| 36-Month Equal Payment Plan | 3 | 12 | 29.24 percent | 11.99 percent | 0.5 percent |
| 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment Plan | 3 | 12 | 27.24 percent | 12.99 percent | 0.5 percent |

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A plan on the 18-Month Deferred Interest Plan with 2 payments sent back unpaid inside the 6 whole months of its review window: the trigger for that term is 2, so the rate is its penalty rate of 31.24 percent.
- A plan on the 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment Plan with 2 returns inside the 12 whole months of its review window and automatic payment in force: the trigger is 3, so the rate is 12.99 percent reduced by 0.5 percentage points, that is 12.49 percent.
- The same plan with 2 returns and no automatic payment: the rate is its promotional rate of 12.99 percent.
